Buff.DisplayText: %b1 Doublestrike %v1%: Passive: %v1% %b1 bonus to Doublestrike. Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Riposte: When its wearer is successfully attacked in melee, this shield occasionally allows him or her to make an immediate counterattack, dealing bludgeoning damage to the offending enemy.
%v1 Enhancement Bonus: Weapons and Shields: %v1 Enhancement bonus to Attack and Damage rolls. Armor and Shields: %v1 Enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
